The 60 hierarchical labels are synthetic: four angles, five native shapes,
font sizes 0.889/1.0/1.27 mm. native-matrix.json records their actual KiCad
10.0.6 SVG stroke bounds. It qualifies text direction/offset, not the entire
label contour or arbitrary font metrics.

The <=1KB positive/negative fixtures derive one hierarchical label from
circuitdojo/nrf9151-feather@43c5345c791a2980d2780249f40804ea39342cf9,
CERN-OHL-S-2.0 (License.txt). The negative adds a foreign wire through text.
